title: Score HUD Setup
description: Create a Canvas with a Text element that displays a score, updated via a script when a button is clicked.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Build a simple score counter UI.

1. In the Hierarchy, right‑click → UI → Canvas. This creates a Canvas and an EventSystem.
2. Select the Canvas, in Inspector, set Canvas Scaler UI Scale Mode to Scale With Screen Size, Reference Resolution 1920x1080.
3. Right‑click the Canvas → UI → Text. Name it "ScoreText".
4. Set the Text's font size to 36, color to white, and type "Score: 0" in the Text field.
5. Right‑click Canvas → UI → Button. Set its text child to "Add Score".
6. Create a C# script `ScoreManager`.
7. In the script, add `using UnityEngine.UI;`. Declare a `public Text scoreText;` and a `private int score = 0;`.
8. Write a public method `AddScore(int amount)` that increments score and updates `scoreText.text`.
9. Attach the script to an Empty GameObject (e.g., "GameManager"). Drag the ScoreText into its scoreText slot.
10. In the Button's OnClick, drag the GameManager into the slot, and select ScoreManager → AddScore. Set the parameter to 10.
11. Play. Click the button; the score should increase by 10.

Take a screenshot of the Canvas and Inspector with the OnClick list.
hints: Make sure the EventSystem is present; it's automatically created.
To access UI classes, add `using UnityEngine.UI;`.
The button's OnClick needs a method with a single int parameter (or none).
expectedOutput: Score text updates from 0 to 10, 20, etc., when button clicked.
